SELECT 
TOP (1000001) *
FROM 
(

SELECT [t2].[account_class] AS [c11],SUM([t3].[amount])
 AS [a0]
FROM 
((
select [$Table].[date_key] as [date_key],
    [$Table].[month_key] as [month_key],
    [$Table].[org_key] as [org_key],
    [$Table].[account_key] as [account_key],
    [$Table].[amount] as [amount],
    [$Table].[load_date] as [load_date]
from [dw].[spike_v_fact] as [$Table]
) AS [t3]

 LEFT OUTER JOIN 

(
select [$Table].[account_key] as [account_key],
    [$Table].[account_code] as [account_code],
    [$Table].[account_name] as [account_name],
    [$Table].[account_class] as [account_class]
from [dw].[spike_v_dim_account] as [$Table]
) AS [t2] on 
(
[t3].[account_key] = [t2].[account_key]
)
)

GROUP BY [t2].[account_class]
)
 AS [MainTable]
WHERE 
(

NOT(
(
[a0] IS NULL 
)
)

)
